features.title: Map presentation
features.goal: Show real geography in a readable pixel-art world.
rules: Keep provider attribution visible in all styles.
Camera changes never change gameplay position or rewards.
Unavailable tiles must not lose recorded walks.
Map opening does not start recording. Show labeled preview without a valid permitted fix.
The first Expo entry slice opens a Ljubljana preview in pixel mode without requesting location or creating a walk.
Give the initial basemap attempt 3 seconds to show a drawable raster or pixel tile, then offer retry. Keep the preview shell usable throughout.
features.endResult: A usable map with explicit loading/error states and independently controlled camera.

scenarios.given: A visible map and active walk
scenarios.then: position, discoveries and XP remain unchanged

scenarios.given: The tile provider is unavailable
scenarios.when: open the map and record a walk
scenarios.then: show failure/retry state and retain the walk

scenarios.given: A loaded map
scenarios.when: switch between pixel and normal styles
scenarios.then: both styles retain provider attribution

scenarios.given: An initial basemap attempt with no drawable tiles
scenarios.then: offer retry; retry begins a fresh loading attempt and the first visible tile clears the message

scenarios.given: The first drawable raster or pixel tile arrives before the deadline
scenarios.then: keep the map visible without an unavailable message

features.title: Accounts and session recovery
features.goal: Let a player securely return to their own progress.
rules: Derive identity from authentication.
Support sign-in/out and the selected flow’s verification and recovery.
Never discard queued work on session expiration.
features.endResult: A restored authenticated session or an actionable entry error.

scenarios.given: A new user
scenarios.when: register and verify using the chosen auth flow
scenarios.then: a single profile is created and map entry succeeds

scenarios.given: Invalid credentials or expired session
scenarios.then: deny access, show a useful error, and preserve pending work

scenarios.given: A player who lost access
scenarios.then: regain only their own account

scenarios.given: A signed-out player
scenarios.when: open Map or a destination directly
scenarios.then: show account entry before any gameplay or location request

features.title: Navigation and app shell
features.goal: Make the core player flow reachable and reversible.
rules: Use Expo Router.
Keep business logic outside routes.
Unconfigured services fail clearly.
Open into Map after bounded branded loading; browsing is available before account/permission prompts.
Map, Activity, Guild, Goals and Profile are primary destinations. Require authentication to record durable rewarded activities, not to browse.
features.endResult: Entry, map, permission, summary, territory and profile routes share one consistent state.

scenarios.given: An active or paused expedition
scenarios.then: restore the exact preceding lifecycle state and totals

scenarios.given: A persisted pending summary
scenarios.when: return to map then reopen the summary
scenarios.then: the same expedition remains queued and visible

scenarios.given: Map Home is open with a walk paused
scenarios.when: visit Activity and return to Map
scenarios.then: show the current session in Activity and retain the paused walk and totals on Map

scenarios.given: A signed-in player launches the development shell
scenarios.when: browse Map, Activity, Guild, Goals and Profile then return to Map
scenarios.then: all five destinations are reachable without location permission; unavailable services are explained and no walk starts

scenarios.given: A signed-in player on the full-height Map
scenarios.when: start, pause and finish a walk, open Activity, then record and finish a second walk
scenarios.then: Activity lists both completed walks from this session in order, and the Map keeps its Start walk control

features.title: Versioned geographic rules
features.goal: Make client preview and server decisions reproducible.
rules: H3 IDs are strings; never reinterpret demo cell keys.
Record resolution, units, supported region and rules version.
Field-test thresholds; define path coverage, boundaries and captured-interior discovery before persistence.

The M0 sample-only trial uses h3-samples-v1 at resolution 11. Use H3 point containment for globally valid coordinates, deduplicate in first-seen order, and reject invalid coordinates or unknown versions. This trial derives no traversed or captured interior.

h3-walk-segments-v1 reveals cells touched by reliable segments, using resolution 11 and straight lines in locally unwrapped WGS84 coordinates between accepted fixes. Segment changes, poor fixes, gaps over 15 seconds and speeds over 4 m/s break continuity. Latitude beyond 85 degrees is explicitly unsupported for this trial.
features.endResult: Documented rule decisions and shared deterministic geographic fixtures.

scenarios.given: The same trace and rules version
scenarios.then: candidate cells and reasons agree exactly

scenarios.given: A boundary/antimeridian or unsupported-region trace
scenarios.then: apply the documented boundary policy or explicit rejection without giant accidental capture

scenarios.given: Synthetic street, park, antimeridian and high-latitude samples
scenarios.when: index them with H3 at trial resolutions 10 and 11
scenarios.then: return valid string IDs at the requested resolution and match the documented H3 reference coordinate

scenarios.given: The versioned H3 sample-only rules
scenarios.when: evaluate duplicates, an antimeridian trace, invalid coordinates and an unknown version
scenarios.then: return first-seen unique string cells for valid samples, one local cell for the fixture crossing, and explicit reasons for incompatible input

scenarios.given: A reliable walking segment crosses three cells and its endpoints occupy two
scenarios.when: evaluate normally and with a pause, poor fix, long gap, jump or unsupported latitude
scenarios.then: include the middle cell only for the reliable segment, reject unsupported latitude, and match the local server result

features.title: Accepted walking samples
features.goal: Prevent invalid movement from creating demo progress.
rules: Only finite, in-range coordinates with finite nonnegative timestamps and known accuracy from 0 through 50 m are accepted.
Samples must have strictly increasing timestamps.
Movement below 3 m is jitter and grants no distance.
Movement faster than 4 m/s is rejected, using actual elapsed seconds even below one second.
Weak/invalid fixes break continuity; recovery establishes a new baseline.
A speed jump earns no cells or distance; it establishes a new baseline.
Paused or finished walks ignore samples; finish requires explicit reset to start another demo walk.
Elapsed-time updates must be finite and positive, and only count while running.
An interval greater than 15 seconds since the accepted baseline starts a new segment and contributes no connecting distance (D05 trial).
A location-service interruption explicitly clears continuity.
Displayed accepted position does not move to a rejected fix; preserve the last accepted position with uncertainty handled by the UI.
features.endResult: Only accepted movement contributes distance and sample-cell discovery; no bridge spans a rejected gap.

scenarios.given: A new demo walk
scenarios.when: walk 0.0001 degrees north on the equator over ten seconds
scenarios.then: record approximately 11.12 meters

scenarios.given: An accepted starting point
scenarios.when: jump one latitude degree in one second
scenarios.then: award no distance or additional discovery

scenarios.given: An accepted start followed by weak GPS
scenarios.when: recover far away after the gap
scenarios.then: start a new segment without bridging the gap

scenarios.given: An accepted start
scenarios.then: do not grant any additional discovery

scenarios.given: An accepted start
scenarios.then: do not grant distance or discovery

scenarios.given: A paused walk
scenarios.then: do not count movement or active time

scenarios.given: A paused walk
scenarios.then: start from a new baseline

scenarios.given: A finished walk
scenarios.then: remain finished without progress

scenarios.given: A valid baseline
scenarios.then: ignore it entirely

scenarios.given: A weak-fix gap
scenarios.when: send a stale sample then recover
scenarios.then: do not reconnect through the stale sample

scenarios.given: A running walk
scenarios.when: send negative or zero elapsed updates then two valid seconds
scenarios.then: count exactly two seconds

scenarios.given: A valid starting point
scenarios.when: move about 3.34 meters in half a second
scenarios.then: reject movement faster than 4 m/s without discovery

scenarios.given: A valid starting point
scenarios.then: do not add distance

scenarios.given: An accepted start followed by silence
scenarios.when: receive a plausible movement after 16 seconds
scenarios.then: start a new segment without connecting the unobserved interval

scenarios.given: An accepted start
scenarios.when: receive a location-service interruption then recover
scenarios.then: retain progress but establish a new baseline

scenarios.given: An accepted displayed position
scenarios.then: keep the accepted displayed position instead of teleporting the marker

scenarios.given: An accepted displayed position
scenarios.then: keep the accepted displayed position

features.title: Foreground expedition lifecycle
features.goal: Record only deliberately started foreground walking.
rules: Start idle and request permission only through the start flow.
Permission alone is not a valid fix.

Pause, signal loss and actual tracking interruptions break segments. The M1 foreground alpha interrupts on backgrounding; validated M3 background recording may continue across screen lock without inventing gap samples.
Separate active time from wall-clock duration.
features.endResult: Explicit idle/waiting/active/paused/interrupted/finished states with accurate statistics.

scenarios.given: A fresh install with denied permission
scenarios.then: show denial and permit browsing without recorded progress

scenarios.given: An active walk
scenarios.then: in the foreground alpha, no background gap earns progress and resume starts a new segment; full background support is separately gated by BACKGROUND

scenarios.given: An idle screen
scenarios.then: no expedition time, discovery or XP accrues

scenarios.given: The walk is idle
scenarios.when: submit a sample, then explicitly start and receive poor followed by usable GPS
scenarios.then: stay idle until start and start recording only on the usable sample

scenarios.given: An active walk with about 11 metres recorded
scenarios.when: interrupt, wait, resume and receive a fix far away
scenarios.then: preserve distance, exclude interrupted time and begin a new display segment

features.title: Durable drafts and migrations
features.goal: Protect an unfinished walk from app termination.
rules: Persist samples incrementally.
Finish and outbox insertion are atomic.
Migrations preserve existing drafts; define mobile and browser support separately.
features.endResult: Recoverable account-owned drafts and a durable completed expedition.

scenarios.given: A recorded active draft
scenarios.then: offer recovery or explicit discard; recovery starts a fresh segment

scenarios.given: A draft during finish
scenarios.then: recover either the draft or the complete queued expedition, never a half-finished record

scenarios.given: An existing database with pending work
scenarios.then: preserve samples, account ownership and queue contents

scenarios.given: An account has a draft with a stored sample
scenarios.when: reopen SQLite, try a different account, then fail and retry finalization
scenarios.then: the owner retains the draft after the failed write and one pending result after retry, and the other account sees neither

features.title: Local account isolation
features.goal: Keep each player’s private data and queue separate.
rules: Partition local data by account.
Never submit under the wrong session.
features.endResult: Switching accounts does not leak or lose another account’s data.

scenarios.given: Account A has a pending walk
scenarios.when: sign out and enter account B
scenarios.then: B cannot read or submit A’s walk

scenarios.given: A has preserved pending work
scenarios.then: A can resume synchronization of the same expedition ID

features.title: Persistent personal discovery
features.goal: Let players retain the world they have explored.
rules: Use approved H3 traversal of valid segments.
Separate pending discovery from confirmed discovery.
Ownership changes never erase personal discovery.
Record the captured-interior discovery policy before M4; first-discovery rewards remain separate from seasonal capture rewards.
features.endResult: Persistent, account-specific revealed cells across restarts and devices.

scenarios.given: A confirmed discovered cell
scenarios.then: the cell remains personally discovered

scenarios.given: A weak fix or interrupted segment
scenarios.then: no intervening cells become discovered

scenarios.given: An already visited cell
scenarios.then: do not count another first discovery

features.title: Validated expedition submission
features.goal: Accept immutable authenticated traces within explicit limits.
rules: Derive owner from auth; do not trust submitted XP/owners.
Validate coordinates, order, time, segments, mode, rules version and payload limits.
Define clock skew, rate limits and retryable versus terminal errors.
Discovery-only submission and result lookup must work before territory capture is available.
features.endResult: An authorized accepted payload or actionable rejection without reward.

scenarios.given: A payload claiming another user or fabricated rewards
scenarios.then: deny impersonation and ignore/reject client reward authority

scenarios.given: Invalid, oversized, reordered or unsupported-version input
scenarios.then: reject with a stable reason and no database effects

scenarios.given: An ID already submitted
scenarios.then: reject the conflict without altering the original result

features.title: Territory capture and preview
features.goal: Convert eligible walking geometry into bounded territory.
rules: Use approved closure, minimum distance, area and perimeter thresholds.
Small simple loops may capture interior; large/open routes capture only the approved path band.
Reject self-crossing interiors and gaps.
Client previews remain provisional; zero capture is valid.
features.endResult: Deterministic eligible cell sets and clear reasons, confirmed only by the server.

scenarios.given: A fixture within approved small-loop thresholds
scenarios.then: include the approved interior and route cells

scenarios.given: A large or open-route fixture
scenarios.then: include only the approved path band

scenarios.given: A self-crossing or interrupted loop
scenarios.then: do not capture the interior across crossings or gaps

scenarios.given: An expedition with no eligible cells
scenarios.then: show zero capture without inventing a failure or reward

features.title: Partial and concurrent takeover
features.goal: Transfer only legitimately captured cells.
rules: Finalize discovery, ownership, reward and result atomically.
Lock contested cells in stable order; document commit ordering.
features.endResult: Consistent cell-level ownership with no partial transactions.

scenarios.given: A foreign territory with ten cells and a capture of two
scenarios.then: only those two change owner

scenarios.given: Two players capture overlapping cells concurrently
scenarios.then: results obey documented ordering without deadlock-induced partial writes

scenarios.given: A failure during finalization
scenarios.then: no discovery, ownership, XP or final result is partially committed

features.title: Authoritative unique rewards
features.goal: Reward confirmed first discoveries exactly once.
rules: First-discovery identity is user + cell + reason, independent of expedition.
Only authoritative expedition finalization updates confirmed totals. Discovery-only XP ships in M2 without capture; M4 extends that transaction with ownership.
Profile level derives from the approved reward/level schedule.
First-discovery base XP and uniqueness remain consistent per user/cell across all modes; mode-based activity/goal rewards are separate reward reasons.
features.endResult: A durable ledger whose totals cannot be inflated by replay or concurrency.

scenarios.given: Two different expeditions for one user reveal the same new cell
scenarios.then: award one first-discovery reward total

scenarios.given: A finalized expedition
scenarios.then: return the same result without additional XP

scenarios.given: A pending expedition
scenarios.then: pending XP is separate from confirmed XP

scenarios.given: A cell already rewarded during a walk
scenarios.when: revisit it during running and cycling
scenarios.then: grant no additional first-discovery reward in either mode

features.title: Durable outbox and retry
features.goal: Eventually deliver completed expeditions without duplicate effects.
rules: Retry with bounded backoff under the original account and ID.
Continue after summary closes.
Preserve immutable payload; handle response loss, offline state and expired auth.
features.endResult: Each queued walk reaches a visible confirmed or rejected state.

scenarios.given: A walk finished offline
scenarios.then: submit persisted work and show its authoritative result

scenarios.given: Server commits but its response is lost
scenarios.then: recover one result and one reward

scenarios.given: A terminal rejection
scenarios.then: show reason without retrying forever or blocking unrelated valid entries

features.title: Multi-device reconciliation
features.goal: Display current server state without losing personal progress.
rules: Use versioned snapshots or cursors with pagination and deletion handling.
Stale caches cannot overwrite newer ownership.
Rollback rejected provisional overlays.
features.endResult: Two devices converge to the same confirmed discoveries, ownership and totals.

scenarios.given: A second device with no local walks
scenarios.then: download existing confirmed discovery and XP

scenarios.given: A stale ownership cache
scenarios.when: apply newer results then an older response
scenarios.then: retain newer ownership and permanent personal discovery

scenarios.given: A rejected provisional claim
scenarios.then: remove the claim preview without erasing confirmed discovery

features.title: Profile, history and summaries
features.goal: Explain progress and every expedition outcome.
rules: Validate profile edits.
Show pending, accepted and rejected outcomes distinctly.
History must paginate without duplicate or missing expeditions.
Full profile adds server-confirmed coin balance, inventory/shop links, achievements and statistics; never merge pending rewards into spendable balance.
Show the saved Walker, Runner or Cyclist specialization; allow free changes without resetting XP, wallet, inventory or history.
features.endResult: Editable identity, confirmed level/XP and recoverable expedition history.

scenarios.given: Confirmed and pending expeditions
scenarios.then: show confirmed totals and separately labeled pending estimates

scenarios.given: A rejected result and an invalid display name
scenarios.when: open summary and save the edit
scenarios.then: show rejection reason and reject invalid profile input

features.title: Server access control
features.goal: Keep tracks, discovery and hidden ownership private.
rules: RLS restricts private rows to their owner.
Public territory projection is bounded and anonymous by default even outside personal fog; private routes, exact live location, identity links and activity media remain audience-controlled.
Block direct reward/ownership writes; never ship server secrets.
features.endResult: Two-user isolation verified against a real test backend.

scenarios.given: Two users with different discoveries and private activity histories
scenarios.when: query tracks, discoveries, identity links and public territory as the other user
scenarios.then: deny private rows and unauthorized identity/media; permit only bounded anonymous territory outside fog

scenarios.given: An authenticated client
scenarios.then: database authorization rejects it

features.title: Retention and account deletion
features.goal: Let players remove private data with defined retention.
rules: Define retention before production collection.
Deletion clears local data and handles server references deliberately.
Redact coordinates and credentials in routine logs.
features.endResult: Documented, exercised removal of user data and expiration of retained tracks.

scenarios.given: A player with tracks and queued work
scenarios.then: remove private data and local queue under the documented ownership/reference policy

scenarios.given: Tracks older than the approved retention period
scenarios.then: delete eligible tracks without corrupting retained reward totals

features.title: Safe and accessible interaction
features.goal: Support understandable walking without unsafe attention demands.
rules: Explain foreground location use and safe/private access boundaries.
Use readable text, accessible labels and adequate targets.
Do not promise safe/public routing.
features.endResult: Core flows usable with a screen reader and without continuous map attention.

scenarios.given: A new player
scenarios.when: complete onboarding with a screen reader
scenarios.then: understand location use and safety; reach start/pause/finish controls

scenarios.given: Large text or a narrow screen
scenarios.then: essential text and actions remain readable and reachable

features.title: Operational release readiness
features.goal: Ship a recoverable and measured mobile release.
rules: Separate development/staging/production.
Prove backup/restore and rollback.
Measure long-walk memory, battery and responsiveness against recorded budgets.
Disable reward-producing development controls.
features.endResult: A reproducible release with recorded device evidence and recovery procedures.

scenarios.given: A production build
scenarios.then: no server secrets or reward-producing simulation controls are exposed

scenarios.given: A staging backup and failed deployment
scenarios.then: recover consistent data and executable service

scenarios.given: The maximum supported expedition
scenarios.then: meet documented budgets and retain the full durable track

features.title: Challenges and achievements
features.goal: Recognize confirmed exploration milestones.
rules: Derive completion from confirmed events.
Version challenge definitions; prevent repeated unlocks.
Achievements are permanent; daily/weekly objective windows and claims are specified by GOALS.
features.endResult: Durable challenge progress and achievements.

scenarios.given: A completed challenge event
scenarios.then: award and unlock once

scenarios.given: A pending or rejected expedition
scenarios.then: do not count it as confirmed completion

features.title: Inventory and cosmetics
features.goal: Let players personalize their character.
rules: Persist earned unlocks across devices.
Cosmetics do not silently modify movement/capture rules.
No payments assumed.
Price and availability come from server catalog; purchase debits and unlocks atomically with a stable idempotency key.
features.endResult: Authorized inventory and persistent selected appearance.

scenarios.given: An unlocked cosmetic
scenarios.when: equip then sign in on another device
scenarios.then: show the same selection

scenarios.given: A locked item
scenarios.then: reject without changing gameplay or selection

features.title: Exploration chests
features.goal: Provide optional exploration rewards after MVP.
rules: Define placement, eligibility and reward balance before implementation.
Server verifies claim and grants each eligible reward once.
Use explicit chest visibility policy separate from public territory; private chest eligibility never leaks through public board queries.
features.endResult: Server-confirmed eligible chest rewards without replay farming.

scenarios.given: An eligible discovered chest
scenarios.then: grant one reward

scenarios.given: A hidden or ineligible chest
scenarios.then: do not disclose hidden placement or award a reward

features.title: Teams and social privacy
features.goal: Enable opt-in group play without exposing raw movement.
rules: Authorize membership, invitations and roles.
Define capture aggregation semantics before team ownership changes.
Provide privacy settings, blocking/reporting and moderation.
Display each member’s saved Walker, Runner or Cyclist specialization separately from Leader, Officer or Member permissions.
Specialization changes update the guild badge and future defaults only; they never grant permissions or rewrite historical contributions.
features.endResult: Consistent team views limited to authorized members and chosen visibility.

scenarios.given: A removed member
scenarios.then: deny access and reconcile cached membership

scenarios.given: A player who has not opted into social visibility
scenarios.when: view team maps or public APIs
scenarios.then: do not expose precise live location or raw traces

scenarios.given: An abusive interaction
scenarios.then: enforce blocking and create a reviewable moderation report

scenarios.given: A guild Member with Walker specialization
scenarios.then: update the guild activity badge while permissions and recorded contributions remain unchanged

features.title: Walk, Run and Cycle activity selection
features.goal: Choose a validated movement mode independently for each expedition.
rules: Version walking, running and cycling validation independently; all three modes are required for full v1.
Validate on physical devices; reject unknown modes.
Before every start show Walk, Run and Cycle, defaulting to the saved specialization. A different choice changes this expedition only.
Lock activity mode and rules version on start; v1 mode changes require finishing the expedition and starting another. No mid-session relabeling or implicit mixed-mode segments.
Persist the chosen mode through pause, interruption, offline submission and retry. Reject conflicting mode changes under the same expedition ID.
Selecting a mode is not proof of effort and never grants a reward multiplier on its own.
features.endResult: Correct mode-specific progress without weakening walking checks.

scenarios.given: A trace acceptable only for running under the approved running rules
scenarios.when: submit it first as walking then as running
scenarios.then: walking rejects disallowed movement and running uses its own approved rules

scenarios.given: An unsupported mode
scenarios.then: reject without rewards

scenarios.given: A player whose preferred specialization is Walker
scenarios.then: record a cycling expedition while the saved specialization remains Walker

scenarios.given: A started Run expedition saved offline
scenarios.when: change mode in a retry payload under the same ID
scenarios.then: reject the conflicting payload without changing original mode or rewards

scenarios.given: A paused Run expedition
scenarios.then: resume as Run; require finish and a new expedition to switch

features.title: Ownership-reset events
features.goal: Refresh territory competition while preserving exploration.
rules: Reset ownership, never personal discovery.
Define event boundaries for pending work and retries.
Preserve lifetime XP, wallet, cosmetics and historical activity snapshots.
Seasonal recapture rewards use a separate capped identity including season; never re-award first-discovery XP after ownership reset.
features.endResult: Deterministic reset outcomes and stable expedition results.

scenarios.given: A player with owned and discovered cells
scenarios.then: clear affected ownership once and preserve discovery

scenarios.given: A pending expedition spanning an event boundary
scenarios.when: submit and replay after the event
scenarios.then: apply documented event policy and return the same result on replay

features.title: Branded loading and map-first entry
features.goal: Open into a useful map quickly without pretending that browsing starts an expedition.
rules: Use the landing-page cream/navy/gold pixel-art style; respect reduced motion.
No forced animation delay, permission loop or infinite network-dependent splash.
Restore local active work before following deep links; first-time account/location requests are contextual.
features.endResult: A restored map/home with clear preview, loading, offline and recovery states.

scenarios.given: A returning player with cached state and slow network
scenarios.then: show a usable map or labeled offline preview within D10 budget; no automatic recording

scenarios.given: Reduced motion and an interrupted activity
scenarios.then: show static loading, recover activity and safely open the linked detail

features.title: Screen-lock activity recording
features.goal: Allow a real run with the phone in a pocket.
rules: Only an explicitly active session records in background.
Use supported native builds and platform permissions; foreground fallback is labeled.
OS termination cannot be promised uninterrupted tracking; recover persisted work with explicit gaps.
Screen-lock evidence must cover walking, running and cycling before full release.
features.endResult: Measured walking/running recording through lock/unlock on the supported device matrix.

scenarios.given: An active permitted native run
scenarios.when: lock for ten minutes, unlock and finish
scenarios.then: retain accepted samples and correct stats without duplicate segments or rewards

scenarios.given: Background access is denied or revoked
scenarios.then: explain foreground-only/interrupted behavior and retain prior samples

scenarios.given: OS terminates the app
scenarios.then: recover persisted draft without connecting the missing interval

features.title: Public territory map and detail
features.goal: Show competition on the map without publishing private movement.
rules: Separate personal fog from public game-board cells.
Use anonymous ownership by default and explicit identity visibility.
Filter mine/others/guild; limit viewport size and pagination.
features.endResult: Current simplified captured areas with correct authorized detail.

scenarios.given: An unexplored viewport containing foreign territory
scenarios.then: show anonymous territory but no raw path, exact live marker or private identity

scenarios.given: A newer takeover followed by a stale response
scenarios.then: keep current version and correct own/foreign style

features.title: Personal capture cards and zone images
features.goal: Make every completed activity understandable and reviewable.
rules: Cards use confirmed capture geometry, area, duration, mode and reward result.
Area is derived from the union of confirmed cells, not a bounding box.
Preserve historical snapshots after later takeovers/reset; mark pending results clearly.
Private by default; thumbnails cannot expose raw endpoints or bypass audience checks.
features.endResult: A personal activity feed and detail with accurate zone image, area and time.

scenarios.given: A confirmed irregular capture
scenarios.then: image depicts the confirmed cell union with its area and active/elapsed duration clearly labeled

scenarios.given: That territory is later lost or reset
scenarios.then: preserve historical capture and label current ownership separately

scenarios.given: An unauthorized user with a private thumbnail URL
scenarios.then: deny access, including after audience revocation

features.title: Earned coins and wallet ledger
features.goal: Provide a durable currency balance that cannot be duplicated or overspent.
rules: Server-authoritative append-only transaction ledger with stable reward/purchase keys.
Amounts are bounded nonnegative integers; balance never goes negative.
No paid currency, trading or client-priced purchases in v1.
features.endResult: Confirmed coin balance with auditable rewards/spending and safe concurrent transactions.

scenarios.given: A reward event delivered twice
scenarios.then: credit exactly once

scenarios.given: Two purchases exceed the available balance together
scenarios.then: only affordable transactions succeed; balance remains nonnegative

scenarios.given: A client proposes a cheaper price or negative amount
scenarios.then: use server price or reject without changing balance/inventory

features.title: Daily and weekly objectives
features.goal: Offer repeatable goals with understandable XP/coin rewards.
rules: Define server-time windows, timezone presentation, late-offline policy and eligibility.
Use confirmed activity events only; reward once per user/objective/window.
Show progress, completion, claimed state and time remaining; do not double-credit replays.
Mode-specific distance/time targets use the confirmed expedition mode, not the player’s current specialization. Shared and mode-specific goals have explicit eligibility and caps.
features.endResult: Daily/weekly goals that roll over predictably and grant each eligible reward once.

scenarios.given: One confirmed expedition meets two distinct objectives
scenarios.then: advance each eligible goal once and grant each reward once

scenarios.given: A client changes timezone/clock across rollover
scenarios.then: server windows prevent duplicate daily/weekly rewards

scenarios.given: An offline expedition arrives after a goal cutoff
scenarios.then: apply the published late-arrival rule and explain eligibility

scenarios.given: A running goal and a completed walking expedition
scenarios.when: change specialization to Runner and replay the event
scenarios.then: do not make the walking expedition eligible or grant another reward

features.title: Friendship and social access
features.goal: Let players intentionally connect and control access.
rules: Explicit request/accept/remove/block lifecycle with server authorization.
Blocked users lose social access and notifications; anonymous public territory remains public.
Provide reporting and reviewable moderation; no chat required.
features.endResult: A controlled friend graph usable by feed and notifications.

scenarios.given: A pending friend request
scenarios.then: deny access until accepted

scenarios.given: An accepted friend is removed or blocked
scenarios.when: query cached feed and image endpoints
scenarios.then: revoke social access and future relevant notifications

features.title: Friends activity feed and sharing
features.goal: See friends’ captured areas without sharing raw movement by default.
rules: Audience private/friends/public is explicit; private is default.
Enforce audience on cards, media and pagination, not only UI.
Show historical zone snapshots; no live tracking or raw route endpoints.
features.endResult: A paginated own/friends feed with safe sharing and revocation.

scenarios.given: A private confirmed activity
scenarios.then: authorized friends see its sanitized card and strangers cannot fetch it

scenarios.given: A post is unshared while its image is cached
scenarios.then: server revokes access according to the defined cache-expiry policy

scenarios.given: New events arrive during pagination
scenarios.then: avoid duplicate or missing stable card IDs

features.title: Territory-loss alerts and event inbox
features.goal: Inform players of important changes without duplicate or invasive alerts.
rules: Persist inbox event with stable ID from committed server event outbox.
Push is optional transport; retry delivery cannot repeat game effects.
Preferences, quiet hours, token/account isolation, grouping and safe deep links are required.
Reset events do not emit a per-cell territory-loss storm.
features.endResult: An inbox and optional grouped push that opens current relevant detail.

scenarios.given: Another player takes several adjacent owned cells in one expedition
scenarios.then: create one grouped territory-loss event with no live attacker position

scenarios.given: Push delivery fails and the user changes account
scenarios.then: retain inbox truth and do not send the old account’s alert to the new session

scenarios.given: A player opens a loss alert during recording
scenarios.then: retain the active recording and show current territory

features.title: Guild competitions and standings
features.goal: Run scheduled fair competitions with understandable progress and rewards.
rules: Server UTC schedule and published scoring, ties, eligibility, cutoff and offline rules.
Snapshot roster/eligibility so switching guilds cannot transfer earned competition score.
Use confirmed events; standings finalize once and rewards are idempotent.
Publish mode-specific objectives or scoring normalization so walking remains a useful contribution alongside running/cycling.
Record contribution mode when earned and snapshot competition eligibility under published rules. Free specialization changes never relabel scores, move categories retroactively or duplicate rewards.
features.endResult: Upcoming/active/completed competitions, guild standings and archived results.

scenarios.given: Two guilds capture overlapping territory during a scheduled event
scenarios.then: use documented score/overlap rules without double counting

scenarios.given: A member switches guild before finalization
scenarios.then: apply the eligibility snapshot and prevent score transfer

scenarios.given: The event closes with a tie and late offline submission
scenarios.then: apply published tie/cutoff rules and pay rewards once

scenarios.given: A scored walking contribution and a later specialization change
scenarios.when: change to Cyclist before finalization and replay the contribution
scenarios.then: retain the original mode/category and award once

features.title: Validated cycling gameplay
features.goal: Deliver cycling as a balanced, physically validated full-release mode.
rules: Do not advertise cycling as delivered until field tests and balance are accepted.
Use independent mode limits and capture policy.
Cycling is required for full v1, not an optional post-launch expansion. Larger travel reach must not automatically dominate capture or rewards.
features.endResult: A validated cycling mode that does not weaken walking/running rules.

scenarios.given: A cycling-speed trace
scenarios.when: submit under walking and cycling rules
scenarios.then: walking rejects it and cycling follows its approved policy

scenarios.given: A permitted active cycling session on each supported reference device
scenarios.when: lock the screen, pause/resume, then finish a representative ride
scenarios.then: meet approved cycling recording/battery budgets and preserve chosen mode and accepted track

features.title: Confirmed discovery progress and private history
features.goal: Prove the complete walk-to-confirmed-XP loop before capture or economy.
rules: Show confirmed XP and level using the approved versioned schedule.
Pending rewards remain separate; account data is private and recoverable on a second device.
Basic private history can exist without capture cards, coins or cosmetics.
features.endResult: A durable confirmed profile total and private expedition result history.

scenarios.given: A walk finished offline and restored after restart
scenarios.then: show one confirmed reward and one private expedition entry

scenarios.given: Confirmed progress on one device
scenarios.when: sign in on a second device
scenarios.then: show the same confirmed XP and history without needing a new local walk

features.title: Changeable player and guild activity specialization
features.goal: Express a preferred activity without restricting what the player can do.
rules: Choose Walker, Runner or Cyclist at setup or in profile settings; Walker is the initial default if setup is skipped.
Changing specialization is free and does not reset progress, currency, inventory or history. Persist it across devices.
Use the preference to preselect the next activity mode, but allow any supported mode before starting.
Guilds display this specialization separately from permission roles. An ongoing activity retains its original mode after preference changes.
Specialization is descriptive, not an administrative permission, reward entitlement or retroactive competition category.
features.endResult: A durable, freely changeable specialization displayed on profile and guild roster, with independent activity choice.

scenarios.given: A player with XP, coins, inventory and history
scenarios.when: change Walker to Runner then sign in on another device
scenarios.then: retain all progress and show Runner as the saved preference

scenarios.given: A running expedition is active
scenarios.when: change the saved specialization to Cyclist
scenarios.then: keep the current expedition Run and default the next expedition to Cycle

scenarios.given: A player without a chosen specialization
scenarios.then: show Walk as the editable default without forcing onboarding

features.title: Effort-balanced mode rewards and capture limits
features.goal: Keep walking, running and cycling rewarding without rewarding speed or role switching by itself.
rules: Separate first-discovery XP from activity/goal/season rewards; first-discovery XP cannot be repeated by changing modes.
Publish versioned mode-specific distance/time targets, eligibility, capture limits and reward caps after representative field tests. Do not invent production multipliers before evidence.
Server recomputes eligibility from validated activity and immutable recorded mode/rules version; the saved specialization never determines historical rewards.
Compare equal-duration representative walks, runs and rides against an approved fairness tolerance (D14). More distance must not automatically mean proportionally greater coins or guild score.
Cycling capture limits are reviewed in M4; combined XP/coin/goal pacing is reviewed in M5 before economy release.
Reject implausible traces under their selected mode; do not silently reclassify a rejected activity into a more lucrative one. GPS validation alone is not proof against all spoofing.
features.endResult: Reviewed mode-specific progression and capture rules with reproducible fairness fixtures and no duplicate reward path.

scenarios.given: Approved equal-duration walking, running and cycling fixtures and fairness tolerance
scenarios.then: stay within the approved normalized reward bounds and published caps

scenarios.given: A fixed recorded Walk activity and rules version
scenarios.when: change preference to Runner or Cyclist before submitting and retrying
scenarios.then: return the same Walk rewards exactly once

scenarios.given: A trace outside selected walking limits
scenarios.when: submit as Walk with a claimed bonus
scenarios.then: reject ineligible movement/bonus without auto-upgrading its mode

scenarios.given: A cycling capture exceeding its approved area or reward cap
scenarios.then: enforce mode-specific capture/reward limits and return an unchanged final result
